description: Return a MoonPay checkout URL for buying ETH or USDC with a card, Apple Pay or bank transfer into wallet_address, in two calls: sign the returned ownership_proof.message with wallet_address, then call again with issued_at and signature. Show the URL to the user; MoonPay handles identity checks and payment on its own page. Live or sandbox per this server's configuration: the result's environment says which, and real_payment is true only for live checkouts.

base_currency_amount.description: Whole fiat amount to pre-fill in major units (50 means $50, not base units), 1 to 999999; MoonPay enforces its own minimum and maximum. Omit to let the user choose

base_currency_code.description: Fiat currency the user pays with; default usd

currency_code.description: Crypto to buy, as MoonPay's code: eth or usdc on Ethereum, or eth_/usdc_ with _base, _arbitrum or _optimism. Sandbox offers only eth and usdc, delivered on Sepolia

wallet_address.description: EVM address that receives the purchase, normally the user's own wallet; MoonPay pre-fills it and the user cannot change it

name: create_moonpay_buy_link
title: Create a MoonPay card checkout link
